build_nlvr_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the NLVR dataset in the ParlAI datapath directory
download_nlvr_resources: download the NLVR dataset zip file from the clic-lab GitHub repository using the RESOURCES list
check_nlvr_built_status: check if the NLVR dataset has already been built in the specified data path directory
remove_outdated_nlvr_data: remove the outdated NLVR dataset directory before rebuilding with fresh downloaded data
mark_nlvr_build_done: mark the NLVR dataset build as complete after downloading all resources to the data path
